title: Floating platform A (40 x 40 m concrete pontoon, low-rise homes)

provenance.basis: Illustrative archetype of Design A in projects/floating-city-design-challenge (scenario SCN_FLOATCITY_COASTAL_01): an idealised concrete box pontoon. draft_m 2.958 is the three-storey case of analysis/results.json (design_A.mid); the fourth storey and the 0.5 m hull extension are parts the story reveals, and their sinking and rising are applied as SEQUENCE MOVE steps with the offsets of analysis/results.json (storey_branch). Not an engineering design; wall and slab thicknesses only serve the mass estimate.
